# HashSemiJoinNode

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Query.Planning.Nodes.HashSemiJoinNode`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Query`

## Summary

Implements semi-join and anti-semi-join for IN (subquery), EXISTS, NOT IN, and NOT EXISTS. Materializes the inner side into a HashSet keyed by the join column, then probes per outer row. Semi-join: yields outer row when key IS found in inner set. Anti-semi-join: yields outer row when key is NOT found in inner set.
